requirements: Every champion ability must include cooldowns.primary.
Every active item and boot enchant must include cooldowns.primary.
Every item passive with trigger timing must include passive cooldown or internal cooldown when source-visible.
Every rune must include cooldowns.primary or explicit source_verified_not_applicable.
Per-rank cooldowns must be arrays, not prose-only text.
Per-level cooldowns must be arrays or raw range plus source_status.
Per-target cooldowns must be separated from global cooldowns.
Recharge systems must include charges and recharge_time_seconds.
If no cooldown exists, use source_verified_not_applicable only when the approved source confirms no cooldown or no active/trigger timer.
